name: LethAL R132 Assert Probe
brief: R132: what does a Microsoft Library Assert failure actually say, and does a dependency on it compile and publish here?
description: Throwaway probe, not for production use. Measures the exact failure text a Library Assert failure produces, which is the text R121's assertion screen keys on ('does the message begin with Assert.'), and proves a fixture can take a Library Assert dependency on these containers at all. See docs/roadmap/R132.md.
